string-array.item: A horse walks into a bar. The bartender asks, "Why the long face?"
A tester walks into a bar. Orders a beer. Orders 0 beers. Orders 999999999 beers. Orders a lizard. Orders -1 beers.
What do you call a boomerang that won\'t come back? A stick.
